text: Tell me the way. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Nightingale. <break time="0.8s" /> For I am not afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> You must make the rose. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of music by moonlight. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the tree. <break time="0.8s" /> All night long. <break time="0.8s" /> You must sing. <break time="0.8s" /> With your breast against a thorn. <break time="0.8s" /> The thorn will pierce your heart. <break time="0.8s" /> And your life will flow. <break time="0.8s" /> Into my veins. <break time="0.8s" /> Death is a great price. <break time="0.8s" /> To pay for a red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the Nightingale. <break time="0.8s" /> And Life is very dear to all. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet Love is better than Life. <break time="0.8s" /> And what is the heart of a bird. <break time="0.8s" /> Compared to the heart of a man. <break time="0.8s" /> She flew back to the Student. <break time="0.8s" /> And said, Be happy. <break time="0.8s" /> For you shall have your red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> All that I ask. <break time="0.8s" /> Is that you will be a true lover. <break time="0.8s" /> The Student looked up and listened. <break time="0.8s" /> But he could not understand her. <break time="0.8s" /> Because he only knew. <break time="0.8s" /> The things that are written in books. <break time="0.8s" /> But the oak tree. <break time="0.8s" /> Who loved the little Nightingale. <break time="0.8s" /> Felt sad. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked her for one last song. <break time="0.8s" /> When she finished her song. <break time="0.8s" /> The Student said. <break time="0.8s" /> She sings beautifully. <break time="0.8s" /> But she has no real feeling. <break time="0.8s" /> She would never give up anything. <break time="0.8s" /> For others. <break time="0.8s" /> He thought.
